ablations.title: Sequential additions
ablations.context: Train85k, 10 epochs and 64 inference candidates are fixed. Each step is conditional on the preceding components.
ablations.note: TC adds 0.10 points, dual-memory CCS adds 0.10, and CSA adds 0.50 in this sequence. The full configuration scores 0.70 points above the base.

ablations.title: Register processing
ablations.context: Dual-memory CCS and CSA are fixed. The register transformation changes.
ablations.note: Scene routing is 0.22 points above uniform expert mixing and 0.28 above the single-SwiGLU control.

ablations.title: Memory fusion
ablations.context: TC, both visual memories and the CSA candidate list are fixed.
ablations.note: Candidate-dependent gating scores 0.16 points above equal averaging.

ablations.title: Scorer supervision
ablations.context: TC and both memories are fixed. The two auxiliary-supervision settings use 256 entries and the same loss weight.
ablations.note: CSA scores 0.40 points above repeating the original candidates four times. CSA does not add model parameters or inference candidates.

ablations.title: Registers per camera
ablations.context: Separate train85k/navtest sweep with CCS and CSA enabled. Compare settings within this sweep.
ablations.note: The sweep default is 91.85, while the sequential-ablation default is 92.40. The paper does not establish the source of this run-group difference.

ablations.title: Expert count
ablations.context: Separate train85k/navtest sweep; all configured experts remain active.
ablations.note: Six experts give the highest reported score within this sweep. These point differences are not estimates of statistical significance.
